posts.mainText: White House released National AI Policy Framework urging federal preemption of state laws for unified coordination on child safety and innovation.
posts.replyText: This promotes coordination by centralizing AI policy, enhances legitimacy via clear legislative recommendations, and ensures neutrality by protecting interstate commerce without stifling development.

posts.mainText: US judge calls Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic troubling, hinting at punishment for AI safety views, challenging procurement neutrality.
posts.replyText: Highlights need for neutral, legitimate government processes in AI adoption; fosters coordination between defense and industry to align safety with national security imperatives.

posts.mainText: OpenAI discontinues Sora AI video app amid rising scrutiny, demonstrating proactive content governance and self-regulation.
posts.replyText: Reinforces legitimacy through voluntary compliance; supports coordination with regulators on generative AI risks, maintaining neutrality in innovation while addressing societal harms.

posts.mainText: EU antitrust chief meets Google, Meta, OpenAI, Amazon CEOs on AI practices, advancing transatlantic regulatory coordination.
posts.replyText: Drives global coordination on AI competition; upholds legitimacy via stakeholder dialogue, ensuring neutral enforcement that balances innovation with fair market practices.

posts.mainText: Maryland General Assembly pauses AI chatbot regulations, paving way for deliberate policy coordination and balanced governance.
posts.replyText: Emphasizes legitimate, measured approaches; aids coordination between states and feds, preserving neutrality by avoiding hasty rules that could hinder AI deployment.
